caseNameFull: McGranery, Attorney General, Successor to the Alien Property Custodian v. Vort, Trustees and Vort, Trustees v. McGranery, Attorney General
attorneys: Solicitor General Cummings in No. 541, and Mr. Cummings, Assistant Attorney General Kirks, James D. Hill and George B. Searls in No. 542, for the Attorney General. Raoul Berger for petitioners in No. 542 and respondents in No. 541.

opinions.text:
